ticket.title: The facts rail's Note, Decisions and Details panels

note.text: Keep the agent description folded by default; the brief is what a person reads first.

brief.text: Adds the last three panels of the ticket page's facts rail: the note for the next run with whether a run read it, the decisions taken on the ticket, and the details looked up rarely, with the brief folded open above the agent's description.
brief.walkthrough: Write a note and save it: the rail shows it with its time and says no run has read it yet. Unfold Details: the brief reads as a person's summary, the agent's description folded under it.
